messages:
nina-sales: Heads up 10x Bank wants a short POC for BYO keys. They need (1) HSM attestation PDFs, (2) a one-time rotation dry-run, (3) pen-test during POC, and (4) a monthly line item for proxy egress. Can sec/sre ops confirm feasibility and costs?

owen-sec: We can share HSM vendor attestation and FIPS certs but must redact internal network details. For BYO appliance path we require chain-of-custody docs and an attestation signing key. Need legal to approve redaction language.

reza-sre: Proxy latency note: in our tests a remote-HSM proxy adds ~0.9ms median in us-east-1, p95 varies 15-45ms depending on network. Recommend KV prefix caching and 50ms RPC timeout for the POC. Rotation dry-run: we prefer a 2.5h window to validate replicas and rollback.

gina-ops: Pen-test during POC OK if tester IPs are whitelisted and test plan shared. Pen-test traffic may trigger rate limits; propose temporary rate-limit exemptions in the test window and an SOW amendment.

nina-sales: Procurement asks whether the rotation dry-run is included in POC scope and if proxy is metered or flat monthly.

kevin-fin: One rotation dry-run (<=3h) is included in the standard POC. Additional ops support billed at $225/hr. Reserved proxy endpoint estimate: $1,100/month in us-east-1 plus egress metering. I'll send a quote.

reza-sre: Add-on: frequent rotations (daily) will increase token cost due to cache invalidations; we should document that for procurement.

ownen-sec: Action items: I
-> prepare attestation artifacts (redacted) by EOD; Reza -> final latency p50/p95 numbers for us-east-1 and eu-west-1; Gina -> draft pen-test whitelist + SOW snippet; Kevin -> formal quote.

ci-bot: env: redwood-poc-10x-2026-03-24 created (proxy-enabled).

nina-sales: Great, I'll consolidate and reply to 10x procurement with proposed kickoff and the dry-run slot. Thanks!
